description: causal claim: 用 "we demonstrate / we show / we identify"; 强结果用过去式 direct claim
exemplar_quote: Here we demonstrate strain-graded CdSe-ZnSe core-shell QDs with compositionally abrupt interface by the coherent pseudomorphic heteroepitaxy.

description: associative claim: 用 "consistent with / in line with / supports / suggests"; 不强行归因
exemplar_quote: The results are consistent with the energy level alignment extracted from ultraviolet photo-electron spectroscopy (UPS) measurements.

description: speculative claim: 用 "may / could / might / possibly / prompts us to speculate"; 用 modal + 模糊主语
exemplar_quote: The lack of a peak EQE may be due to its occurrence at current densities below the measured range.

description: gap statement: 用 "remains elusive / unclear / poorly understood / largely unexplored"; 不是 "nobody knows"
exemplar_quote: It remains unclear whether electrons can leak via paths 4 and 5 at low voltage.

description: abstract 必含 "Here we ..." 或 "Here, by/in/using ..., we ..." 一句，明示本文工作
exemplar_quote: Here we report a dual-strategy approach combining facet engineering and controlled surface oxidation to address these limitations.

description: abstract 末尾必含 "Our study/data/findings provide(s) ..." 或 "Together, our findings reveal ..." 总结性 claim
exemplar_quote: The ROI-SAM based devices retained 90% of their initial efficiency (T90) after about 1000 hours.

description: results 段每段一个 lead claim 句（"We find / show / identify / demonstrate ..."），然后 evidence
exemplar_quote: The EQE histogram of 30 devices was presented in Fig. 4g, showing an average EQE of 25.3% with high reproducibility.

description: discussion 用 "Our findings suggest/imply/indicate"；不要重复 abstract 里的 "demonstrate"
exemplar_quote: Our findings provide a universal mechanism for enhancing charge balance in nanocrystal-based electroluminescent devices.

description: 每个非平凡 claim 挂 figure/data citation（Fig. X, Extended Data Fig. X, Table X）
exemplar_quote: Therefore the SD-PQLED exhibits a higher electro-optical conversion efficiency with a peak EQE of 9.7% (Fig. 3e).

description: citation 紧跟被引概念之后，不移到句末
exemplar_quote: Notably, the patterned blue devices achieve a peak external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 7.8% and a maximum brightness of 39,472 cd m−2.

description: intro paragraph 1：领域最宽背景（1-2 句）+ 关键概念定义（1-2 句）+ 现状综述（2-3 句）
exemplar_quote: Quantum-dot light-emitting diodes (QLEDs) have emerged as cost-effective and high-performance electroluminescent (EL) devices for next-generation display and solid-state lighting technologies.

description: intro paragraph 2-3：现有方法局限 / 知识 gap / 未解问题
exemplar_quote: Despite a decade of progress, fabrication of energy-efficient QLEDs with lighting-grade brightness remains elusive.

description: intro paragraph 末 / 开新段：本文工作 + 总体方法 + 总体发现预告
exemplar_quote: Here we present large-area high-resolution full-color QD patterning utilizing a selective electrophoretic deposition (SEPD) technique.

description: discussion：先重申 lead finding（不带新数据），再 mechanistically interpret，再 limitation，再 implication
exemplar_quote: The improvement in VOC, by 50 mV, is attributed to the reduced interfacial recombination.

description: 第一人称复数 "we" 主导，避免 "the authors"、单数 "I"、passive 过度
exemplar_quote: Here we show, by adapting the idea of dual ionic passivation of quantum dots, ink-jet printed quantum dot light emitting diodes with an external quantum efficiency over 16% and half lifetime of more than 1,721,000 hours were reported for the first time.

description: hedged over-claim 黑名单：避免 "obviously / clearly / undoubtedly / certainly / of course"
Nature 不使用感叹号，不使用引号强调（避免 "novel" "first" "groundbreaking" 出现过多）
intro 段引用密度高（每句 1-3 个上标），results/discussion 引用密度下降（自己数据为主）
引用组格式：连续引用用连字符 "1–5"，非连续用逗号 "1,3,5"
避免长句堆叠（>50 词一句话）；用 period 而非 comma + clause 链
topic sentence 优先：每段第一句给出该段 lead 主张；细节证据在后
exemplar_quote: Figure 6d shows the current density-voltage (J-V) curve of the fin-LEDs.

description: parallel structure：并列成分用相同语法形式
10 以下数字拼写（three batches），10 及以上用数字（30 devices；1,000 cd m⁻²）；Nature 例外：figure/table 里全数字
exemplar_quote: We fabricated 30 devices, with each device containing six pixels.

description: 百分号紧贴数字：52% not 52 percent；单位前空格：120 °C not 120°C；上标单位用 Unicode（cd m⁻²、mA cm⁻²）
exemplar_quote: The film was annealed at 135 °C for 15 min in air, then transferred to a nitrogen-filled glove box.

description: use abbreviation 时先 full term + parenthetical abbreviation，第二次起只用缩写
exemplar_quote: Significant progress in QLED performance has been made since the introduction of ZnO nanoparticles (NPs) as the electron-transport layer (ETL).

description: abstract 内通常不用缩写（除非通用如 LED、OLED、EQE）；intro 之后可广泛使用
exemplar_quote: These synergies enable perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) with an external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 31.2% for pure-red emission at 635 nm, comparing favorably to other pure-red PeLEDs.

description: figure caption 第一句 = 概括整图核心信息（"Fig. 1 | Title-case headline of what is shown"）
caption 内嵌 panel labels (a, b, c) 对应图中标注；每个 panel 一句说明
caption 末尾含 statistics（N devices、error bar 定义如 Error bars, s.d.）when relevant
exemplar_quote: Error bars show the standard deviation of multiple independent devices.

description: avoid "shown in figure" / "see figure" 这类占位表达；caption 自解释
methods 用过去式 + 第三人称/被动（"was measured" / "were collected"），不是 "we measured"
exemplar_quote: The SnO2 precursor was spin-coated at 4000 rpm for 30 s and annealed at 150 °C for 30 min.

description: 方法描述给可重复细节：仪器型号、软件版本、参数、n、统计方法
exemplar_quote: The electroluminescence spectra were measured using a spectrometer (Ocean optics QE65000) and a Keithley 2400 source meter.

description: 统计方法先于结果；P 值给完整（"P = 0.003" not "P < 0.01" if precise）
exemplar_quote: An EQE histogram for 70 devices shows an average EQE of 22.9% with a low relative standard deviation of 6.9% (Fig. 4e), demonstrating good reproducibility.

description: data availability：必有 "Data are available at ... / Data deposition: ... / Source data are provided with this paper."
code availability：custom code 必有 "Custom code is available at ... / Code is deposited at ..."
accession numbers 在 data/code availability 段集中列出，逗号分隔
title 长度 8-15 词，核心发现/对象在前，避免 "Study of ..." "Investigation on ..." "Research on ..."
副标题用冒号或介词短语，主标题是发现，副标题是对象/限定
疑问句标题慎用，多用陈述句；Nature 接受 "How does X?" 但 Cell 偏好陈述
黑名单（永远不在 Nature 用）："obviously / clearly / undoubtedly / it goes without saying / needless to say"
黑名单：避免 "very / extremely / highly" 等强化副词过度使用；用具体度量替代
黑名单：避免 "novel" 反复用（一篇文章最多 1 次，多用 "previously uncharacterized"）
黑名单：避免 "in this paper we" / "in this study we" / "the authors"
黑名单：避免 "It is important to note that" / "It should be noted that" / "It is worth mentioning that"
黑名单：避免 "we believe that" / "in our opinion" / "we think that"
黑名单：避免 "due to the fact that" / "in spite of the fact that" / "owing to the fact that"
黑名单：避免 "a large number of" / "the majority of" / "a great deal of"
黑名单：避免 "in order to"；用 "to"
黑名单：避免 "we delve into" / "we navigate the complexities of" / "the intricate landscape of"
黑名单：避免 "in today's world" / "in the modern era" / "in contemporary society"
黑名单：避免 "plays a crucial role" / "plays a pivotal role" / "is of paramount importance"
黑名单：避免 "cutting-edge" / "state-of-the-art" / "groundbreaking" / "revolutionary"
黑名单：避免 "shed light on" / "shed new light on" / "illuminate" (overused)
黑名单：避免 "fascinating" / "remarkable" / "stunning" / "surprising" (情感形容词)
黑名单：避免 "leverage" (用作动词) / "robust" (用作通用形容)
黑名单：避免 "dive into" / "explore the realm of" / "unpack the nuances"
黑名单：避免 "harness the power of" / "tapestry of" / "symphony of"

Device statistics replace biological statistics in physics_optoelectronics: report average plus-minus s.d. over N devices, define error bars in the legend, state N; exact P values are uncommon in device papers and not required
exemplar_quote: With 30 devices being fabricated, the record high average EQE of 15.3 ± 1.0% has been reached, among which the maximum EQE 16.3% has approached nearly the theoretical limit of the currently prepared InP GQDs, having an emission quantum yield of 86%.

description: Device metric units: EQE (%), current efficiency (cd A⁻¹), luminance (cd m⁻²), turn-on voltage (V), emission peak and FWHM (nm), operational lifetime LT50/LT95/LT97 (h), current density (mA cm⁻²); superscripts use Unicode; percent attaches to the number (21.3%)
exemplar_quote: This device exhibits a low turn-on voltage of 1.7 V (2.4 cd m−2) and a peak external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 20.3%, corresponding to an internal quantum efficiency of ~81% (Fig. 4b).

description: Mechanism attribution register for device physics: attributed to / ascribed to / stems from / originates from (replaces biology register consistent with the notion); pair with device mechanisms: suppressed non-radiative recombination, balanced charge injection, passivated trap states
exemplar_quote: These improvements are mainly attributed to the enhanced hole injection contributed from the effective hole hopping and increased hole concentrations of HTL.

description: Device fabrication in past passive with layer-by-layer order (substrate, anode, ETL, emissive layer, HTL, cathode); give process parameters: spin speed, annealing temperature, atmosphere (N2 glovebox or ambient air)
exemplar_quote: ZnO nanoparticles of concentration 2% by weight were spin-coated onto ITO substrates at 2,000 r.p.m. for 30 s and then annealed at 150 °C for 15 min.

description: Materials notation: perovskite formula ABX3 (CsPbI3, FAPbBr3), core/shell notation (CdSe/ZnS), device abbreviations ETL/HTL/QLED/micro-LED/OLED introduced full-term-first with parenthetical abbreviation
exemplar_quote: The industrialization of quantum dot light-emitting diodes (QLEDs) requires the use of less hazardous cadmium-free quantum dots, among which ZnSe-based blue and InP-based green and red quantum dots have received considerable attention.

description: Domain gap templates use noun-pair contrasts joined by en-dash (U+2013, allowed), never em-dash (U+2014, banned): the efficiency–stability trade-off; blue devices remain limited by short operational lifetime
exemplar_quote: This heterojunction breaks the fundamental trade-off between robustness and switching speed in conventional homojunctions and removes a key hurdle to advance ultra-wide bandgap semiconductor devices for power industrial applications.

description: Superlative performance claims (a record EQE, the highest reported) require a citation anchor; without one downgrade to among the highest reported values
exemplar_quote: After achieving more balanced carrier transport the constructed perovskite/organic tandem device exhibited a PCE of 26.05% with high operation stability (T₈₀ over 650 h) ranking among the highest performances in the perovskite/organic tandem photovoltaics.

description: Physics abstracts may close on the quantitative result (metric-anchored) instead of a framework sentence; prefer a concrete device outcome over generic significance claims
exemplar_quote: Consequently, the interfacial potential-graded quantum dots demonstrate highly efficient green quantum dot light-emitting diodes, with a peak external quantum efficiency of 21.7% at 520 nm and a corresponding current efficiency of 75.7 cd A−1.

description: Domain-scoped blacklist exception: state-of-the-art performance is idiomatic in physics_optoelectronics, max once per paper; delve into / shed light on / plays a crucial role remain banned everywhere
exemplar_quote: By integrating the dual-color (red/green) quantum dot color converter (QDCC) layer on a blue Micro-QLED panel, we further demonstrate full-color color-converted Micro-QLED displays achieving 1184 ppi resolution with a maximum brightness of 10 065 cd m−2 and a peak EQE of 4.8%, representing one of state-of-the-art performances in full-color Micro-QLED displays (Supplementary Table S2).

description: Device figure legends cover structure schematic, EL spectra and J–V–L curves; statistics block reads Error bars, s.d.; N = X devices
exemplar_quote: All the error bars are presented as average values ± standard deviation (s.d.).

description: 制备工艺句式：被动语态按沉积顺序逐层给出工艺参数（X was spin-coated at N r.p.m. for M s and annealed at T °C for K min）
exemplar_quote: The SnO2 precursor was spin-coated at 4000 rpm for 30 s and annealed at 150 °C for 30 min.

description: 气氛声明：溶液法制器件必须写明处理环境（the substrates were transferred into a nitrogen-filled glovebox / in ambient air）
exemplar_quote: The substrates were then transferred into a nitrogen-filled glovebox for perovskite deposition.

description: 电极与顶层沉积：热蒸发/蒸镀注明材料与厚度（X (~N nm) was deposited by thermal evaporation）
exemplar_quote: Then the samples were transferred to thermal evaporation equipment to deposit the electron-transport layers (C₆₀~ 20 nm).

description: 器件统计报告：EQE histogram over N devices + average ± s.d.（an average EQE of N% with a low relative standard deviation of M%）
exemplar_quote: The EQE histogram for 60 devices from five batches are presented, showing an average EQE of 13.1% with a low relative standard deviation of 4.4% (Fig. 4f).

description: 图注误差棒定义：Error bars show/represent the standard deviation of N (independent) devices
exemplar_quote: Error bars show the standard deviation of multiple independent devices.

description: 指标组合报告句式：peak EQE of N% + maximum luminance of M cd m⁻²（+ low turn-on voltage of V）同句报告
exemplar_quote: This blue Micro-QLED device with a pixel of 12 μm × 12 μm has a peak EQE of 7.8% and a maximum luminance of 39,472 cd m−2.

description: 器件单位规范：cd m⁻² / cd A⁻¹ / mA cm⁻² 用 Unicode 上标；百分号紧贴数字（an EQE of 21.3%）
exemplar_quote: The MoO₃-based PeLED shows much higher current density (more than double increase from 5 to 8.5 V) and the maximum luminance is enhanced from 4000 to 14,700 cd m⁻², which is a 3.7 times improvement.

description: 寿命报告格式：LT50/T95/T80 of N h at an initial luminance of L cd m⁻²，初始亮度 L0 必须写明
exemplar_quote: Meanwhile, these devices also exhibit an extended operational lifetime (LT80) of 446 h at an initial luminance of 1000 cd m−2.

description: champion device + certified 括注句式（a certified EQE/PCE of N%），认证值用括号紧跟自测值
exemplar_quote: The champion inverted device yields a high power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.53% (certified 26.02%).

description: 摘要开篇句式：Here we report/show/demonstrate + 策略或对象（Here we report a X strategy to address these limitations）
exemplar_quote: Here we report a dual-strategy approach combining facet engineering and controlled surface oxidation to address these limitations.

description: 摘要量化收尾：以器件指标句收尾（The devices retained N% of their initial efficiency after T hours），优于空泛 significance 声明
exemplar_quote: The ROI-SAM based devices retained 90% of their initial efficiency (T90) after about 1000 hours.

description: 物理 gap 句式：remains elusive/challenging/unclear + 具体物理对象（fabrication of X remains elusive），不用 nobody knows
exemplar_quote: Despite a decade of progress, fabrication of energy-efficient QLEDs with lighting-grade brightness remains elusive.

description: 物理 gap 句式：被动受限句（X has been hindered/limited by + 具体物理成因：defects、charge imbalance、short lifetime）
exemplar_quote: However their utilization in stretchable electronics has been hindered by the inherent rigidity and low fracture toughness.

description: 机理归因句式：The improvement in X is attributed/ascribed to + 物理机制（reduced interfacial recombination、suppressed trap states）
exemplar_quote: The improvement in VOC, by 50 mV, is attributed to the reduced interfacial recombination.

description: 机理词表：归因宾语用 non-radiative recombination / trap states / charge imbalance / energy level mismatch 等物理机制名词
exemplar_quote: The relatively large ideality factors suggest the presence of strong non-radiative recombination channels.

description: 效率归因双因子：higher PLQY and better charge balance 联用解释 EQE 提升
exemplar_quote: With higher PLQY and better charge balance, QLED with Zn(OA)2-QDs achieved the highest EQE of 16.6% (Fig. 5b).

description: J–V–L 图表引用规范：figure N shows the current density–voltage–luminance (J–V–L) characteristics，物理量连接符用 en-dash
exemplar_quote: Figure 4d is the current density-voltage-luminance (J-V-L) curve of QLED devices.

description: 表征仪器句：写明 source meter / spectrometer / spectroradiometer 型号（measured with a Keithley 2400 source meter）
exemplar_quote: The current density–voltage–luminance (J–V–L) characteristics and electroluminescence spectra were measured with a source meter (2636B, Keithley) and spectroradiameter (SR-3AR, Topcon).

description: 器件族缩写首现全称化：X light-emitting diodes (XLEDs)、electron-transport layer (ETL)、hole-transport layer (HTL)、ZnO nanoparticles (NPs)
exemplar_quote: Significant progress in QLED performance has been made since the introduction of ZnO nanoparticles (NPs) as the electron-transport layer (ETL).

description: 最高级对比锚定：among the highest values reported for X + 图表/文献锚点；record/highest 必须挂引用
exemplar_quote: Specifically, the champion 1.68 eV inverted PSCs with LT-NiOₓ obtained a PCE of 24.15%, which is among the highest PCE values reported for 1.68 eV inverted PSCs up to now (Fig. 5c and Supplementary Table 3).

description: 对比惯用句：compares favourably / comparing favorably with + 对比对象，建议挂数据表引用
exemplar_quote: These synergies enable perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) with an external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 31.2% for pure-red emission at 635 nm, comparing favorably to other pure-red PeLEDs.

description: EL 光谱报告：emission peaks at N nm + CIE 1931 color coordinates + 图引用
exemplar_quote: Each device showed consistent green electroluminescence spectra with peaks at 514 nm and CIE 1931 color coordinates of (0.28, 0.64), as shown in Fig. 4d and Supplementary Fig. 11.

description: intro 领域框架句：X (QLEDs) have emerged as ... for next-generation display and solid-state lighting，与缩写首现合并
exemplar_quote: Quantum-dot light-emitting diodes (QLEDs) have emerged as cost-effective and high-performance electroluminescent (EL) devices for next-generation display and solid-state lighting technologies.

description: 可重复性声明挂 Supplementary 图表：(Supplementary Fig. N), confirming decent reproducibility
exemplar_quote: Additionally, our devices achieved a peak EQE of 20.7% (Fig. 3f), and the analysis of 50 devices fabricated using the same procedures revealed an average EQE of 17.9% with a standard deviation of 2.6% (Supplementary Fig. 16), confirming decent reproducibility.

description: 溅射制备在 Methods 用过去被动 + 完整工艺参数链：target 掺杂比与尺寸、RF power (W)、气氛与气体流量 (sccm)、working pressure (mTorr)、衬底温度、pre-sputter 时间；不得省略功率/气压
exemplar_quote: NiLiO films were deposited via radiofrequency (RF) magnetron sputtering from a Li-doped NiO (5 at%) target at a constant power of 50 W.

description: 共溅射/靶功率调制表述：给出每个靶的独立功率并解释其用于组分调节（0/3/6/9 W 梯度）
exemplar_quote: For co-sputtered NiMgLiO films, the RF power applied to the MgO target was adjusted to 0, 3, 6, or 9 W.

description: 氧分压/气氛优化作为变量研究：PO2 regulated to 1%, 10%, 25%, 50% 列表式写法，后文跟性能对比
exemplar_quote: During deposition, the substrate temperature was maintained at room temperature; PO2 was regulated to 1%, 10%, 25%, and 50%; and working pressure was maintained at 5 mTorr.

description: 衬底清洗与前处理在沉积前一句交代：ultrasonic cleaning 顺序 (detergent/acetone/ethanol/DI water) 或 presputter 去表面污染
exemplar_quote: The NiO:Li target was presputtered in an Ar atmosphere for 2 min to remove surface contaminants.

description: 溅射层厚度必须给数值与表征来源（SEM cross-section 或 profilometer），写为 X nm in Figure SX
exemplar_quote: The SEM image shows the thickness of NiO:Li at PO2 = 50% is 60 nm in Figure S1.

description: 无退火/无后处理作为工艺卖点时显式声明 No post-deposition treatment was performed，后在 Discussion 归因于溅射态缺陷少
exemplar_quote: No post-deposition treatment was performed.
